p: patiently for the LORD: Though God deferred his help, yet he patiently abode till he was heard.
horrible pit: He has delivered me from great dangers.
a new song in my mouth: That is, a special opportunity to praise him, for God's benefits are so many opportunities for us to praise his Name.
not the proud: To follow their example, which he must do who trusts not only in the Lord.

O LORD my God: David goes from one king of God's favour to the contemplation of his providence over all, and confesses that his counsels toward us are far above our capacities, we cannot so much as tell them in order.

mine ears hast thou opened: You have opened my ears to understand the spiritual meaning of the sacrifices: and here David esteems the ceremonies of the law as nothing in respect to the spiritual service.
Then said I: When you had opened my ears and heart, I was ready to obey you, being assured that I was written in the book of your elect for this end.
great congregation: In the Church assembled in the sanctuary.

faithfulness and thy salvation: David here numbers three degrees of our salvation: God's mercy, by which he pities us, his righteousness which signifies his continual protection and his truth, by which appears his constant favour, so that from this our salvation proceeds.
faileth me: Concerning the judgment of the flesh, I was utterly destitute of all counsel, yet faith inwardly moved my heart to pray.
ashamed and confounded together that seek: He desires that God's mercy may contend for him against the rage of his enemies.
desolate for a reward of their: Let the same shame and confusion come on them, which they intended to have brought on me.
The LORD be magnified: As the faithful always praise God for his benefits, so the wicked mocked God's children in their afflictions.
